title: Control the order campaigns are presented in
summary: Set the order in which live campaigns appear in the mobile site's campaign carousel for each display type using Campaign Prioritisation.
bodyMd:
Campaign Prioritisation sets the order in which live campaigns appear in the campaign carousel, per display type. The order applies to the mobile site of every display of that type.

Before you begin

  • Your campaigns are set up and enabled for the mobile site. See Choose which campaigns appear in the campaign carousel.

Steps

  1. In the left navigation, select Campaigns.
  2. Select Campaign Prioritisation.
  3. Find and select the display type you want to update.
  4. Select Update Priorities.
  5. Use the up and down arrows to move each campaign into position.
  6. Select DONE.

Verify it worked

Scan the QR code on a display of that type. The carousel presents the live campaigns in the order you set.

Next step
